title: Identify language and script
condition: When Sanskrit is explicit, record sa-Deva or sa-Latn as supplied; sa alone needs script confirmation.
guidance: When Sanskrit is explicit, record sa-Deva or sa-Latn as supplied; sa alone needs script confirmation. Devanagari also writes other languages. Never infer Sanskrit from script alone.
exception: Hindi or Marathi text receives no Sanskrit editorial adoption.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Protect exact source
condition: Before review, retain source bytes, names, numbers, quotations, code and line structure.
guidance: Before review, retain source bytes, names, numbers, quotations, code and line structure. Keep all suggestions separate; normalization is never authorization to rewrite.
exception: A separately authorized normalized derivative must not replace the original.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Keep conjuncts intact
condition: When Devanagari is supplied, preserve virama, consonant sequences, matras, repha, ZWJ/ZWNJ and logical order.
guidance: When Devanagari is supplied, preserve virama, consonant sequences, matras, repha, ZWJ/ZWNJ and logical order. Review grapheme and shaping clusters in the target engine before any break or spacing adjustment.
exception: Do not simulate visual order by moving Unicode code points.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Respect line boundaries
condition: For Devanagari compounds, try column width and language-aware line breaking before hyphenation.
guidance: For Devanagari compounds, try column width and language-aware line breaking before hyphenation. Do not insert spaces or discretionary characters into Sanskrit automatically.
exception: Manual educational segmentation belongs in a separately labelled derivative.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: IAST is explicit
condition: For sa-Latn preserve ā ī ū ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ ṅ ñ ṭ ḍ ṇ ś ṣ ṃ ḥ and combining forms exactly.
guidance: For sa-Latn preserve ā ī ū ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ ṅ ñ ṭ ḍ ṇ ś ṣ ṃ ḥ and combining forms exactly. Ask which transliteration scheme is intended; do not equate IAST and ISO 15919 or auto-transliterate.
exception: Roman letters or diacritics alone do not prove Sanskrit.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Accents require expertise
condition: If Vedic accents occur, retain all marks and ask for tradition, edition and specialist reference.
guidance: If Vedic accents occur, retain all marks and ask for tradition, edition and specialist reference. Check mark collisions in the exact font/renderer; report linguistic correctness needs-review.
exception: Classical Sanskrit coverage does not certify Vedic recitation or manuscript readings.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Preserve verse structure
condition: For verse keep pāda, stanza, caesura markers and numbering supplied by the edition.
guidance: For verse keep pāda, stanza, caesura markers and numbering supplied by the edition. Avoid changing line order to balance a display layout; metrical weight is not pixel width.
exception: A poster may propose an alternative layout only beside the complete reading text.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Punctuation is contextual
condition: When danda, double danda or avagraha occurs, preserve it and confirm edition conventions before proposing alternatives.
guidance: When danda, double danda or avagraha occurs, preserve it and confirm edition conventions before proposing alternatives. Modern punctuation is not a universal error.
exception: Do not project a textbook convention onto every historical manuscript or script.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Compare font coverage
condition: For Devanagari compare licensed Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit, Shobhika or Noto candidates on the actual source, including conjuncts and accents.
guidance: For Devanagari compare licensed Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit, Shobhika or Noto candidates on the actual source, including conjuncts and accents. Record file version and fallback. No font bytes are bundled.
exception: Font family reputation is not evidence of complete Sanskrit coverage.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Check IAST fallback
condition: When mixing Devanagari and IAST, inspect all diacritics at body and note sizes; record the actual fallback face.
guidance: When mixing Devanagari and IAST, inspect all diacritics at body and note sizes; record the actual fallback face. Do not substitute plain Latin letters to conceal missing glyphs.
exception: Coverage and visual rhythm need separate checks.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Readable body first
condition: For screen reading compare source-text specimens at audience-appropriate sizes and widths, then test zoom/reflow.
guidance: For screen reading compare source-text specimens at audience-appropriate sizes and widths, then test zoom/reflow. A research starting point of 20–24 CSS px and line-height 1.65–1.9 for experienced adult Devanagari readers is untested guidance, not a standard.
exception: For IAST, UI, print or different audiences choose a separate comparison rather than reusing this range.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Avoid clipped marks
condition: For UI labels and slides containing stacked marks, remove fixed-height clipping risks and test ascent, descent and fallback at final size.
guidance: For UI labels and slides containing stacked marks, remove fixed-height clipping risks and test ascent, descent and fallback at final size. Prefer flexible containers and wrap checks over letter compression.
exception: Static source diagnostics cannot establish rendered ink bounds.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Separate original and translation
condition: When Sanskrit, IAST, translation and commentary coexist, distinguish language and role semantically and visually while retaining corresponding verse or paragraph anchors.
guidance: When Sanskrit, IAST, translation and commentary coexist, distinguish language and role semantically and visually while retaining corresponding verse or paragraph anchors. Do not shrink a primary reading route into decorative notes.
exception: Translation and transliteration require separate explicit authorization.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Chanting layout
condition: For recitation material compare restart positions, verse spacing and accent visibility with practitioners of the specified tradition.
guidance: For recitation material compare restart positions, verse spacing and accent visibility with practitioners of the specified tradition. Keep a full readable text alongside expressive headings.
exception: No universal chanting font size or tradition-wide validation is claimed.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Accessible expression
condition: For graphic headings retain a selectable textual equivalent and readable hierarchy.
guidance: For graphic headings retain a selectable textual equivalent and readable hierarchy. Check contrast, zoom, reflow and reading order in the target output; never label a static-only review accessible PASS.
exception: WCAG text-spacing override resilience is not a universal Sanskrit initial tracking value.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Spacing respects clusters
condition: For Devanagari avoid arbitrary tracking inside shaping clusters; inspect word spacing, column width and paragraph rhythm first.
guidance: For Devanagari avoid arbitrary tracking inside shaping clusters; inspect word spacing, column width and paragraph rhythm first. For IAST compare actual diacritics before display tracking.
exception: A visual treatment may be proposed separately, preserving source and reading copy.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Print needs physical checks
condition: For print compare body, note and caption samples at final scale; retain marks in embedded fonts and test search/copy and print output.
guidance: For print compare body, note and caption samples at final scale; retain marks in embedded fonts and test search/copy and print output. Separate PDF export from native document acceptance.
exception: No Office, PDF renderer or physical print result is implied by this package.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Historical scripts are bounded
condition: For Grantha, Śāradā, Siddham, Newa, Rañjanā or a manuscript transcription, retain exact supplied content and require script-specific expertise.
guidance: For Grantha, Śāradā, Siddham, Newa, Rañjanā or a manuscript transcription, retain exact supplied content and require script-specific expertise. Do not apply sa-Deva glyph rules as universal Sanskrit rules.
exception: Coverage here is sa-Deva and explicitly identified IAST; other scripts are needs-review.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Keep rights explicit
condition: Before recommending or redistributing a font, inspect its actual license and version.
guidance: Before recommending or redistributing a font, inspect its actual license and version. A free download is not redistribution permission; Murty licensing differs from open-font licensing.
exception: Only the official product PNG and Apache-2.0 product files are included.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked

title: Report evidence limits
condition: Return source hash, explicit locale/script, medium, relevant rule/source IDs, separate proposals and evidence status.
guidance: Return source hash, explicit locale/script, medium, relevant rule/source IDs, separate proposals and evidence status. Record host, renderer, browser, assistive technology and native Office/PDF checks not_checked until executed.
exception: A byte-integrity PASS is not a typography, language or rendering PASS.
verification: source-informed conditional guidance; native rendering not_checked
